specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent raster VFX sprite atlas for a smartphone-only dark Japanese post-apocalyptic side-view strategy game. Create ONE sprite sheet, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, six equally sized square cells, overall 3:2 landscape canvas (ideally 1536x1024). Read frames left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row. It is a single coherent 0.54-second one-shot animation, not six different design alternatives. Every cell uses the SAME unmoving physical ground anchor at cell center x and 87.9% cell height. Frame1 is the first physical emission, frame2 the forceful peak, frame3 expanding matter, frame4 falling fragments, frame5 dispersing haze, frame6 a small residual. Strong physical painted detail with cinematic readable silhouettes, irregular matter, excellent smooth visual continuity. Genuine transparent RGBA background throughout; no opaque background, no floor plane, no checkerboard, no grid lines, no text or numbers, no UI. At least 20px fully transparent safety margin inside ALL FOUR edges of EVERY cell, with dust and smoke fading naturally to exact transparency, no effects crossing cell boundaries. These are environmental/attack particles only: absolutely no people, animals, monsters, faces, anatomy, limbs, weapons, buildings or intact armor. No circles, rings, symbols, polygons, flat vector art, diagrams, starburst icons or clean geometric light shapes. The large peak must feel powerful yet remain contained in each cell, leaving open transparent space between particles.
Specific effect: one directional rupture of scorched copper flecks, small dark grit and fine rose-grey dust from a fast impact. It begins compact at the fixed ground pivot, unfurls asymmetrically to the right in two interweaving physical streams, then fragments tumble down as the powder disperses. This effect will be triggered separately by each of two already separated enemy owners; do not draw either owner, a pair of creatures, a fused body, hands, faces, ribs, limbs, a cross symbol, or a magical X. Copper and charred-binding material accents are tiny environmental particles only. Express an aggressive coordinated strike through material motion, not a diagram or ring.
